gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In the first installment of Stephen King's epic fantasy series, a lone gunslinger embarks on a quest to find the enigmatic Man in Black, navigating a desolate landscape filled with danger and mystery. gpt-4o-mini.title: Gwendy's Final Task
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A captivating conclusion to the Gwendy's Button Box trilogy, exploring themes of fate and choice.

gemma2:9b.title: Everything's Eventual: 14 Dark Tales
gemma2:9b.explanation: A collection of chilling short stories by Stephen King, this book delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the supernatural, showcasing his signature blend of suspense and psychological depth. Each tale offers a unique exploration of fear, fate, and the unexpected twists of life.

gemma2:9b.title: Later
gemma2:9b.explanation: A coming-of-age story with supernatural elements, told through the eyes of a boy who can speak to the dead.

gemma2:9b.title: The Institute
gemma2:9b.explanation: Children with special abilities are kidnapped and held in a sinister institution.
